name: memoryprocess
description: Windows process-memory toolkit — N-API bindings, Process engine, CLI, and MCP server. A ground-up rewrite of memoryjs.

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/bindings' build && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/core' build && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/cli' build && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/mcp' build
scripts.check: bun run build:bindings && bun run build:core && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/bindings' check && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/core' check && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/cli' check && bun run --filter '@memoryprocess/mcp' check

author: JoShMiQueL
